description: This file contains unit tests for the `PermissionManager` class and related permission handling logic, particularly focusing on permissions such as voice wake, location, and other capabilities. It uses a testing framework to define test cases verifying permission status querying and ensuring capabilities, with specific checks for location authorization states.

classes.name: PermissionManagerTests
classes.description: A test suite struct containing multiple asynchronous test functions for permission management logic.

methods.name: voice wake permission helpers match status
methods.description: Tests that the granted permissions for voice wake match the permissions returned by ensuring permissions.

methods.name: status can query non interactive caps
methods.description: Verifies that querying the status for a list of capabilities returns the correct count of results.

methods.name: ensure non interactive does not throw
methods.description: Ensures that attempting to ensure certain capabilities without interaction does not throw an error and returns the correct number of permissions.

methods.name: location status matches authorization always
methods.description: Checks that the permission status for location matches the instantaneous authorization status from CLLocationManager.

methods.name: ensure location non interactive matches authorization always
methods.description: Ensures that permission enforcement for location when non-interactive reflects the current authorization status.
